# bioexcel/biobb_dna/biobb_curves

## Summary

Wrapper for the Cur+ executable  that is part of the Curves+ software suite.

The Cur+ program is used to analyze the structure of nucleic acids and their complexes.

Nextflow adapter of the [Curves](https://biobb-dna.readthedocs.io/en/latest/curvesplus.html#module-curvesplus.biobb_curves) building block of [biobb_dna](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_dna) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_DNA_BIOBB_CURVES } from 'bioexcel/biobb_dna/biobb_curves'

workflow {
    BIOBB_DNA_BIOBB_CURVES(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_struc_path` | yes | trj, pdb, netcdf, nc | Trajectory or PDB input file |
| `input_top_path` | no | top, pdb | Topology file, needed along with .trj file (optional) |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_cda_path` | yes | cda | Filename for Curves+ output .cda file |
| `output_lis_path` | yes | lis | Filename for Curves+ output .lis file |
| `output_zip_path` | no, opt-in | zip | Filename for .zip files containing Curves+ output that is not .cda or .lis files |
| `versions_biobb_dna` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_dna', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Curves properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_zip_path: 'zip']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_dna container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_DNA_BIOBB_CURVES' {
        ext.properties = [stdlib_path: 'standard']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `s1range` | string | null | Range of first strand. Must be specified in the form "start:end". |
| `s2range` | string | null | Range of second strand. Must be specified in the form "start:end". |
| `stdlib_path` | string | "standard" | Path to Curves' standard library files for nucleotides. If not specified will look for 'standard' files in current directory. |
| `itst` | integer | 0 | Iteration start index. |
| `itnd` | integer | 0 | Iteration end index. |
| `itdel` | integer | 1 | Iteration delimiter. |
| `ions` | boolean | false | If True, helicoidal analysis of ions (or solvent molecules) around solute is carried out. |
| `test` | boolean | false | If True, provide addition output in .lis file on fitting and axis generation. |
| `line` | boolean | false | if True, find the best linear helical axis. |
| `fit` | boolean | true | if True, fit a standard bases to the input coordinates (important for MD snapshots to avoid base distortions leading to noisy helical parameters). |
| `axfrm` | boolean | false | if True, generates closely spaced helical axis frames as input for Canal and Canion. |
| `binary_path` | string | "Cur+" | Path to Curves+ executable, otherwise the program wil look for Cur+ executable in the binaries folder. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
